analysis.title: McGraw Hill (MH): F2Q First Take: Revenue and EPS beat mitigated by margin shortfall with the full year outlook reaffirmed
key_insights: MH F2Q 2027 (reported 5 Nov 2026) revenue of $632.2mn fell 5.5% y/y, better than GS forecast of down 6.3% and FactSet consensus of down 6.0%. EPS of $0.75 beat GS $0.64 and FactSet $0.72.

Adjusted EBITDA margin of 39.6% contracted 320 bps y/y on negative operating leverage and missed GS at 40.3% and consensus at 40.1%. Adjusted EBITDA of $250.6mn compares with GS $252.7mn and FactSet $252.4mn.
GS expects a mixed investor reaction: revenue and EPS beat, margins fell short, and the full-year guide was only reiterated.

By segment, K-12 revenue fell 9.6% y/y on lower capture rates in select math markets, partly offset by share gains and strong capture rates in most other markets. Higher Education was up 0.2% y/y (flat in the body text) on share gains and price realization, offset by a print decline. Global Professional fell 2.7% on print contraction. International rose 1.6% as delayed Middle East shipments were fulfilled.
Recurring revenue (65% of total) fell 2.0% y/y. Digital revenue (57% of total) rose 2.6%.
MH reiterated F2027 guidance: revenue $2,115-2,175mn, recurring revenue $1,587-1,627mn, EBITDA $750-790mn. The implied midpoint margin is 35.9%, up 50 bps y/y.

Guidance points to stable consensus for revenue and EBITDA margin. Pre-print GS F2027 estimates were revenue $2,142mn and EBITDA $769mn (35.9% margin). FactSet consensus was revenue $2,148mn and EBITDA $772mn (35.9% margin).
Management said it is gaining share in higher education, benefits from 100mn active curriculum licenses globally, and is an early mover on agentic AI in education.
GS expects call focus on K-12 capture rates across subjects including math, K-12 TAM growth expectations for next year, higher education share trends, and how AI is driving the business.

market_movers.rationale: Target is 6.5x NTM+1 EBITDA of $846mn, with NTM net debt of $2,208mn and 188.9mn shares. The multiple is a discount to the Info Services peer median of 12.5x for lower EBITDA growth and higher leverage. Price was $12.76 at the 4 Nov close, implying 33.2% upside.
